description: This file defines the LoggerRendererMap class, which manages mapping objects to renderers in a logging framework. It includes methods for adding renderers, finding renderers for objects or classes, and retrieving default renderers. The class interacts with external components like LoggerObjectRenderer, LoggerDefaultRenderer, and LoggerLog.

classes.name: LoggerRendererMap
classes.description: A class responsible for mapping objects to their respective renderers and providing rendering services within a PHP logging framework.

methods.name: LoggerRendererMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the internal map and default renderer.

methods.name: addRenderer
methods.description: Associates a renderer with a specific class within a logger hierarchy.

methods.name: findAndRender
methods.description: Returns the string representation of an object using the appropriate renderer, or default renderer if none found.

methods.name: getByObject
methods.description: Retrieves the renderer for a given object based on its class.

methods.name: getByClassName
methods.description: Finds the closest renderer in the hierarchy for a class name, or returns the default renderer.

methods.name: getDefaultRenderer
methods.description: Returns the default renderer used for objects without a specific renderer.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Registers a specific renderer for a class.

methods.name: rendererExists
methods.description: Checks if a renderer class exists, attempting to include it if necessary.
